title: lophochloa cristata var. pumila
intro: Lophochloa cristata var. pumila, commonly known as Dwarf Hairgrass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Hairgrass include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Hairgrass may also possess antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its therapeutic potential.
